name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 2px inner #fff at 100% opacity. This gives keyboard users a clear, unbroken ring that survives dark backgrounds and high-contrast modes without fading into noise. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on small touch targets, but the extra 1px width improves visibility for low-vision users and costs nothing in performance.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring risks failing WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast on light backgrounds—#005. A 1px ring with a 2px outer glow (#005fcc) meets contrast at 4.5:1 while keeping focus visible. Test both in dark/light modes and high-contrast Windows mode—if the glow flickers or feels unstable, revert to the 2px ring.
